title: One canonical catalog and source-offer boundary
application: Retain existing canonical identity and private source records; creative references enter a review queue and never become a second PIM.

title: Separate creative canvas from verified imprint geometry
application: Preflight now labels manufacturing requirements unverified. A versioned, exact provider geometry/profile resolver is still open.

title: No universal DPI, bleed or color defaults
application: Remove generic manufacturing thresholds from preliminary preflight; measure pixels/physical placement and retain null requirements.

title: Independent readiness for each intended use
application: Creative draft, preview, marketing, quote, proof, production and provider acceptance have separate evidence requirements.

title: Provider-specific process and layer semantics
application: Keep print, white/primer/varnish, foil, cut/crease and nonprinting guide roles separate; map target names in reviewed output profiles.

title: One original artwork and immutable lineage
application: Retain originals, content hashes and exact configuration; extend safe edit/export fidelity rather than creating a separate editor.

title: Artwork interoperability is destination-specific
application: Treat PNG/SVG/PDF interchange and native AI/AIT/Canva features as separate tests with explicit loss reports.

title: Batch and compliance evidence follows the finished product
application: Track intended use, responsible party, applicable jurisdiction and evidence; never infer all liability or certification from a supplier name.

title: Claims and rights need field-level authority
application: Publish only allowed media and substantiated product/environmental claims, retaining effective dates and revocation history.

title: Program and kit identity survives commerce
application: Continue the actual cart/quote/order context repair; do not add an independent budget or bundle subsystem.

title: Partner handoff includes uncertainty and acceptance
application: Approved payload, transfer and acknowledgment are separate; reconcile ambiguous outcomes before repeating a write.

title: Full versus partial feeds are explicit
application: A missing row in a partial feed does not mean discontinued; snapshot scope, cursors and failure checkpoints survive replay.

title: Direct native integrations and licensed discovery
application: Use direct reviewed supplier profiles and authorized ASI interfaces. PSRESTful remains prohibited.

title: Operational reporting measures owner workload
application: Measure touches, active minutes, waiting causes and direct profit per owner hour; no invented savings or readiness percentage.

title: Advanced engines remain reserved
application: AI design, automatic digitization, validated 3D, CAD, GL/payroll, enterprise MRP and autonomous purchasing stay Coming Soon.

title: Standards and research have scoped versions
application: Maintain exact publisher, edition, access level, scope and review date; a standard abstract or association logo does not certify an output.
